faq.a: Yes. You can start chatting for free without an account. Premium removes the daily limits and adds filters.

faq.q: Do I need to sign up?
faq.a: No. Press Start chatting and confirm you are 18+. Create an account later to add friends, message them and keep your history.

faq.q: How old do I have to be?
faq.a: You must be 18 or older. Accounts under 18 are not allowed and will be banned.

No. Video goes through a secure media server and is not stored. If someone reports you or you report someone, a screenshot and the recent chat lines are saved for moderators and deleted after a retention period.

faq.q: Someone broke the rules. What do I do?
faq.a: Press Report on their video, choose a reason and you move on to someone new. Moderators review reports, and repeat offenders are banned, including by device.
Your device checks the stranger’s video and hides it if it looks explicit. It is also sent to moderators. You can show it anyway or press Next.

faq.q: What do the daily limits mean?
faq.a: Free accounts have a daily number of chat minutes and matches. Premium has no limits. The timer in the call shows how much time you have left today.

faq.q: Can I choose who I meet?
faq.a: Premium members can pick a country and a gender. If nobody matches for a while, the filters are relaxed so you are not left waiting.
